name: Do I need an architect for a whole-home renovation, or can a design-build firm handle everything?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an architect for a whole-home renovation, or can a design-build firm handle everything?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a whole-home renovation, especially one involving significant structural changes or a complete aesthetic overhaul, an architect is often essential for detailed planning and ensuring structural integrity. A design-build firm like Opus Builders offers the advantage of integrating architectural design, interior design, and construction services under one roof. This streamlines the process, improves communication, and often leads to a more cohesive and efficient project delivery. While an architect can be hired independently, a design-build approach provides a single point of responsibility and accountability from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: An architect is often needed for significant structural changes. A design-build firm integrates architectural and construction services, streamlining the process and providing a single point of accountability.
